projects.title: Customer Experience Analytics Dashboard
projects.summary: End-to-end Power BI dashboard suite consolidating customer experience KPIs, survey data, and operational metrics into a single interactive reporting platform.
projects.problem: The organization lacked a centralized view of customer experience performance. Data was scattered across multiple spreadsheets and manual reports, making it difficult for leadership to track KPIs or identify improvement areas quickly.
projects.solution: Built a multi-page Power BI dashboard connecting data from multiple sources. Designed DAX measures for KPIs including NPS, CSAT, and operational efficiency scores. Implemented automated data refresh and drill-through views for granular analysis.
projects.results: Leadership reporting time reduced significantly. Decision-makers now have real-time access to CX metrics, enabling faster identification of issues and more data-driven interventions.

projects.title: MIS Reporting Automation System
projects.summary: Automated the end-to-end MIS reporting workflow using Advanced Excel, Power Query, and Google Apps Script — eliminating manual data compilation and enabling one-click report generation.
projects.problem: The team spent 10+ hours per week manually compiling data from multiple sources into weekly and monthly MIS reports. The process was error-prone and time-consuming, delaying insights for management.
projects.solution: Designed an automated data pipeline using Power Query and Excel macros to pull, clean, and consolidate data from multiple sources. Built dynamic report templates that auto-populate on data refresh. Extended automation using Google Apps Script for Google Sheets-based workflows.
projects.results: Weekly reporting time reduced by over 70%. Reports now generate automatically with a single refresh, freeing the team to focus on analysis rather than data compilation.

projects.title: Market Research Data Analytics Platform
projects.summary: Built a structured data collection and analysis platform for market research projects, using automated survey tools, Python-based data processing, and interactive Excel dashboards.
projects.problem: Market research data was collected manually and stored inconsistently, making analysis slow and unreliable. There was no standardized process for collecting, cleaning, and reporting research findings.
projects.solution: Created automated Google Form-based data collection workflows connected to Google Sheets for real-time data capture. Built Python scripts for data cleaning, transformation, and statistical analysis. Designed Excel dashboards to visualize research findings.
projects.results: Data collection time reduced significantly. Research reports are now generated faster with consistent formatting, enabling quicker delivery of insights to stakeholders.

projects.title: Automated Survey & Data Collection Tool
projects.summary: End-to-end automated survey system built with Google Forms, Sheets, and Apps Script — with auto-triggered notifications, data validation, real-time reporting, and automated follow-up workflows.
projects.problem: Survey data collection was entirely manual. Responses required manual consolidation, follow-ups were often missed, and there was no way to track response rates or generate reports automatically.
projects.solution: Built a Google Forms and Sheets-based system with Apps Script automation. Added real-time response tracking, automatic email notifications on submission, reminder workflows for non-respondents, and auto-generated summary reports using Sheets formulas and charts.
projects.results: Survey response rates improved. Manual follow-up effort eliminated. Reports are generated automatically and available to stakeholders in real time without any manual intervention.

projects.title: HR Analytics & Attendance Dashboard
projects.summary: Interactive Power BI and Excel dashboard tracking HR metrics including attendance, leave balances, performance KPIs, and workforce analytics for organizational decision-making.
projects.problem: HR data was maintained in disconnected Excel files. Attendance tracking, leave records, and performance data had no unified view, making HR reporting slow and inconsistent.
projects.solution: Designed a consolidated HR analytics dashboard in Power BI and Excel. Built DAX measures for headcount, leave utilization, attendance patterns, and performance KPIs. Added drill-through views for individual employee tracking.
projects.results: HR team now has a single source of truth for workforce data. Attendance and leave reports are generated automatically, and performance tracking is integrated into regular management reviews.
